items.title: Could Apple Face a $17 Billion Child Safety Settlement Like Meta?
items.summary: West Virginia's attorney general just called Meta's $17 billion child safety settlement a smart business move, then pointed directly at Apple as the next target. What he says Apple's iCloud is hiding could upend the privacy brand Tim Cook spent a decade building.

items.title: Beyond Social: Meta Is Buying the Future of Compute So I’m Buying It
items.summary: Meta is quietly assembling one of the largest AI compute empires on the planet, and the funding source hiding in plain sight changes everything about how you should value this stock.

items.title: Qualcomm Stock Pops as Amazon Deal Ramps Up AI Ambitions
items.summary: The chip maker and online retailer are teaming up to build data-center infrastructure, including chips and optical networking products.

items.title: Alphabet Stock Is Pulling Back From Its High. Here’s Why I’d Buy the Dip.
items.summary: Alphabet just posted blowout earnings and yet the stock has shed more than 10% from its peak, leaving investors caught between soaring Cloud growth and a balance sheet that suddenly looks very different from a year ago.

items.title: SanDisk Up Over 40% Past Month: Can the Rally Last?
items.summary: SanDisk has surged more than 40% in a month on AI-driven memory demand. Can strong fundamentals and an upbeat outlook keep the rally going?

items.title: Wall Street Keeps Asking How Much Meta Will Spend. The Better Question Is at What Price to Buy
items.summary: Meta's ad engine is accelerating at a historic pace while the stock sits near a level that has historically signaled a cyclical floor, but the $130 billion capex bet hanging over the company changes every calculation an investor needs to make before touching it.

items.title: AI Stocks: OpenAI Declares The 'AGI Era' Is Here Amid IPO Fervor
items.summary: AI stocks show diverging fortunes in Q3, with Nvidia, Snowflake and Palantir gaining momentum while AMD, Ciena and Google lag.

items.title: AI Could Nearly Triple America's Data Center Footprint by 2030
items.summary: The AI boom is becoming a power-and-real-estate story as developers race to build much larger computing campuses.
